android.title: Bitcoin CryptoWord - Earn BTC
android.summary: Find words, earn Bitcoin.
android.fullDescription:
Earn Bitcoin while playing this game!

Think you are a word guru?  Challenge yourself with Cryptoword.

This word search game has a unique scoring system.  We added a definitions bar at the top of the screen so you can discover and learn new vocabulary as you spell out new ones.  Improve your spelling!

-- How To Earn --

- Before you play, tap on the Wallet button in the homescreen to sign-in and enter your Faucetpay or Binance email.  We will be sending you Satoshis (nano Bitcoins) on sign up.  
- You win more satoshis as you play and can claim every 3 days.
- Score at least 145 points per word to gain 1 satoshi.


---How To Play ---

- Tap or slide to connect letters to form words.
- You can link letters vertically, horizontally and / or diagonally.  Search and Pop the bricks.
- Letter stacks on top of each other once popped.
- The more words you link up, the more points you get 
    Example 
    (Formula: Score = Blocks * Blocks * 5)
    3 letter word = 45
    4 letter word = 80
    ...
    10 letter word = 500
    ...
    20 letter word = 2000

- You get more bonus points when you finish a level with fewer blocks left.

    (Formula: Bonus = 2000 - Blocks * Blocks * 20)
    10 Blocks Left = 0
    9 Blocks Left = 380
    8 Blocks Left = 720
    ...
    All Block Cleared = 2000

- The target score for each level increases in the order of level squared : O(n^2).

- In addition, different color blocks gives you extra points when added up:
   Green - 5 points
   Red - 10 points
   Yellow - 15 points
   Blue - 20 points
   Purple - 25 points.

   They simply add to your word score by the letter.

- When you are stuck or feeling lucky, try to use a Change Coin to change letter (and color) into a new one.

- Your scores are submitted to the Game Centre leaderboard if you are signed in.   Try to beat the high score from players around the world!

Are you looking to learn how to earn Bitcoin, Ethereum, and other cryptocurrencies? 

The exciting world of Bitcoin, blockchain, cryptocurrencies and altcoins is finally at your fingertips!

As we are seeing the rise of the blockchain technologies, we witness how important it is to learn and get educated about them.

We will go over everything there is to know about these emerging new revolutionary technologies.

All the most important sections will be covered, by going over the best resources from the thought leaders and world renown experts about all things blockchain and cryptocurrencies. The material will be divided into 9 sections: Quick introduction to basics about economics, The basics about blockchain, the basics about cryptocurrencies, everything about bitcoin, all the most important altcoins, how to mine cryptocurrencies, how to trade the various coins, how to make a profit from cryptocurrencies by investing long-term, and a few advanced chapters about miscellaneous topics.

At the beginning, we will be covering the essentials about the most basic concepts of economics. That way, you will be prepared for some of the financial jargon that is inevitable when going deep into the world of Bitcoin, blockchain and cryptocurrencies.

We will then continue with the basics about the blockchain technology, the distributed ledger, what problems it helps to solve, what is it applied for, its pros and cons, its security and scalability.

Then we will go a step further and learn about cryptocurrencies. We will dive deep into topics about proof of work, proof of stake, compare cryptocurrencies to blockchain, and the biggest use cases for cryptocurrencies.

After that, we get to one of the most important topics in this entire new world – the famous Bitcoin! We will learn about its history, its economics, its advantages and disadvantages, its safety and security, how to choose a wallet, and the future of Bitcoin.

The next logical step is to cover the most important altcoins. We will be learning about Ethereum and its decentralized apps, then Ripple, Litecoin, Iota, Bitcoin cash, Monero, Eos, Bitcoin SV, Binance coin, Chainlink and Facebook Libra.

When we are done with all the theory, we will start discussing about how to earn with blockchain and cryptocurrencies. We will start with the basics of mining cryptocurrencies, how to mine, Bitcoin mining rigs and pools, how to mine altcoins.

The next way to earn from the cryptocurrencies is through trading. We will cover both the basics and the advanced ways to do it, the best exchanges, how to perform advanced technical analysis, how to avoid the common mistakes, day trading, speculation and staking, and about the HODL concept.

Then we will go into one of the safest ways to turn a profit through cryptocurrencies – by long-term investments. We will learn how to research the market, spot patterns and evaluate risk and reward, how to spot the trends and take advantage of them, the psychology of the public and how it affects the market movements, the whales and the hedge funds that make the biggest moves.

Finally, you will get into the top 1% of worldwide experts on blockchain, cryptocurrencies and Bitcoin by learning about the advanced topics. We will see how we can create our very own cryptocurrency, see the public’s opinion on this new technology, its future and some crazy facts about it, the most important resources you need to be aware of, the blockchain and cryptocurrency community, and how to find a job in a blockchain startup.

Join us on this adventure in this exciting new world. Let's go in depth into all the ways you can succeed with blockchain and cryptocurrencies!

Bitcoin (BTC) and its secrets:
There are two things you need to know about Bitcoin - the cryptographic methods that ensure its security and maintenance, and the ability to view all transaction information between addresses. Secondly, Bitcoin is decentralized and managed by encrypted code within the cryptocurrency. This code tracks the maximum amount of BTC.

What is BTC:
Bitcoin (Named after "bit" - a unit of digital information and "coin" - a coin) is a peer-to-peer payment system that uses the same-named unit for accounting operations. Cryptographic methods are used to ensure the functioning and protection of the system, but all information about transactions between system addresses is available publicly. The smallest transferable amount (the smallest divisible unit) is called "Satoshi" - in honor of the creator Satoshi Nakamoto.

android.title: Learn Bitcoin
android.summary: Learn Bitcoin the safe way
android.fullDescription:
Learn Bitcoin. Skip the casino.
This app is the beginner-to-intermediate guide for people who want to own Bitcoin the right way—in self-custody, without handing the keys to a middleman. Short lessons, plain English, and practical checklists that trade buzzwords for steps you can actually follow.

What you’ll do inside

Start Hub: A guided path from “What is Bitcoin?” to your first safe purchase and secure wallet setup.

Self-Custody Setup & Checklist: Hardware vs. hot wallets, seed phrases, backups, and recovery—organized as tap-through steps so you don’t miss anything.

Wallets 101 (with FAQ): How to choose, set up, and maintain a wallet—plus common pitfalls and how to avoid them.

Seed Phrase Practice: A safe way to rehearse storing and restoring—no real funds involved.

First Transaction Walkthrough: Send, receive, and verify on a block explorer with confidence.

Fees & the Mempool (with a simple fee calculator): Understand why fees move, how to time transactions, and how to avoid paying more than you should.

DCA Planner: Make a calm plan for stacking over time. Education first—no trading signals, no nonsense.

UTXO Consolidation (guide): When and how to tidy your wallet for future fee savings.

Security Basics & OPSEC: Practical threat models for normal humans (and the mildly paranoid).

Lightning Basics: What it is, why it’s fast, and when it makes sense.

Spend & Accept Bitcoin: Tips for paying, tipping, and accepting BTC like you’ve done it before.

Taxes & Reporting (overview): The concepts you should know—so you can talk to a pro without needing a translator.

Glossary: Jargon-free definitions you can actually remember later.

Resources & Tools: Block explorers, reputable vendors, and further study, curated with a Bitcoin-first lens.

Our stance (so we’re clear)

Bitcoin-first. No altcoin casino tours.

Self-custody over custodial convenience. If someone else can reset your account, it was never yours.

Education, not speculation. We don’t promise riches; we help you avoid avoidable mistakes.

Designed for beginners, useful for busy pros
Tap-friendly checklists, short reads, and a neon dark theme that won’t fry your retinas during late-night learning.

Privacy & data
No account required to learn. If you subscribe to the newsletter, we use your email solely for educational updates—you can unsubscribe anytime. See our Privacy Policy for details.

Important
Nothing here is financial, tax, or legal advice. Do your own research, verify, and custody responsibly.

Support
Questions or feedback? Email support@learnbitcoin.app

The Pecu Wallet is a safe and powerful self custody crypto wallet that brings all the benefits of the Pecu Novus Blockchain Network to you.

Transfer and manage digital assets such as PECU coins, tokens and NFT's, connect and control the platforms, DeFi protocols and dApps that your Pecu Wallet  connects with. Place digital assets in escrow with release dates utilizing a no coding required simple smart contract system integrated in the Pecu Wallet. Access the powerful MVault to view your NFTs, see liquidity pool stakes, deposit or withdraw digital assets into your safety deposit box for cold storage.

Connect to the powerful Pecu Terminal which opens up a new world of Pecu Novus Blockchain Network access such as seeing all of your holdings on the dashboard, downloading a validator node that is based on Proof of Time and not Proof of Work or Stake, view  and viewing the public ledger, printing wallet and transaction statements for easy physical record keeping. The Pecu Terminal is in constant development mode so expect to see a news stream, videos, social interaction integration, simple NFT creation toolbox with no coding required, live streams and more in the near future.

VERY EASY TO USE WITH ACCESS TO ALL FEATURES
The Pecu Wallet  was designed to simple to use for anyone regardless of their level of experience. We've made it familiar so that it is easy to navigate yet giving access to powerful features.

PROTECTING PECU NOVUS MEMBERS
The Pecu Wallet has unique features to protect all Pecu Novus Blockchain Network members, from encrypted passwords, to Pin integration and the private key cloaking system that allows Pecu members to use an Access Key as opposed to their Private Key to connect to platforms, dApps and Defi networks. The Access Key serves a dual purpose, to cloak your Private Key and also gives the ability to change your Access Key at anytime with the press of a button from your Pecu Wallet or Terminal, which immediately disconnects your Pecu Wallet from all platforms, dApps and DeFi networks.

AVAILABLE ON ALL PLATFORMS
The Pecu Wallet is available as a desktop and mobile browser app, as a mobile app in app stores and soon as a browser extension. 

GLOBAL INCLUSION
The Pecu Novus Blockchain Network's core focus was global inclusion regardless of location or social standing through the use of a Proof of Time consensus mechanism and not Proof of Work or Stake. The Pecu Wallet adheres to that focus by making it easily accessible and soon providing access to a micro node for a validator to use on their mobile phone, so anyone anywhere can be a validator.

Features:
- Self custody, Pecu members have control of their digital assets at all times
- Simple onboarding and access
- Ability to hold and managed PECU coins, tokens and NFTs created on the Pecu Novus Blockchain Network.
- Access to the MVault to place digital assets in escrow and transfer them into the safety deposit box for cold storage, including NFTs and soon digital documents  
- See the current market value of your entire wallet and each individual digital asset in real-time, with pie charts, total PECU market details
- Print account and transaction statements for physical or digital use
- View your transaction history for all digital assets
- Connect to a growing ecosystem of platforms, dApps and Defi protocols with the toggle of a switch and control when you are connected
- Simple access to the powerful and ever developing Pecu Terminal
- Access the full Pecu Novus public ledger
- Easily receive or transfer using a shareable and printable QR Code
- Restore an existing wallet using a 12-word mnemonic phrase.
- Secure your Pecu Wallet by creating a unique pin and soon biometric authentication

android.title: Cryptowallet.si Mobile Wallet
android.summary: Digital currency wallet for $ARCO, $LANA, $TAJ, $OCP

Current supported blockchains (other coins/tokens can be added by respected coin/token developers):

AquariusCoin - ARCO
LanaCoin - LANA
TajCoin - TAJ
OC Protocol - OCP

- Before sending any funds to your mobile wallet please make sure you have written down wallet backup seed words/mnemonics and choosen a strong password to secure your wallet. 

- If you loose/forget your wallet password or your mobile get stolen/broken/hacked/damaged and you dont have your recovery seed,your coins are lost. We cant help you recover your keys or you mnemonic seed words.
 
- Your wallet is 100% your responsibility. 

- We provide 2-4 backend electrum servers required for wallet to communicate with the blockchains with no uptime guarante (electrum source code is published on Github of supported blockchains/coin and you are free to setup your own electrum server and point your wallet to it)

- Backend electrum servers dont store your coins and only provide the connection the to blockchain network for wallet balance checks and transmission of your transactions once they are signed by you with your private key on your own device. 

- We dont have access to your coins, your seed backup or your private keys. 

- Private keys can be retrieved from the backup seed (again write them down and store them in a safe place, use plain paper and pen, making a screenshot of backup seed in not advised). 

 For support join our Telegram group: https://t.me/CryptoWalletSi

Wallet source code is available on Github: https://github.com/CryptowalletSi/Cryptowallet.si

Tool for private key recovery from backup seeds is available here: https://github.com/CryptowalletSi/bip39

Responsibility of the security of your mobile device is yours alone.

GEA Wallet is a digital wallet that stores, sends, and receives cryptocurrencies. It is a secure and convenient way to manage your crypto assets and can be used to make payments online and in person.
How does GEA Wallet work?
GEA Wallet works by storing your private keys, which are the digital keys that give you access to your crypto assets. Private keys are sensitive information, so it is important to store them securely. GEA Wallet uses encryption to protect your private keys from unauthorized access.
To send or receive cryptocurrencies using a GCWallet, you will need to know the recipient's public key. The public key is a digital address used to identify the recipient's cryptocurrency GEA Wallet.
To make an online payment using a GEA Wallet, you will typically need to enter your wallet address and the amount you want to pay.
Benefits of using GEA Wallet:
* Security: GEA Wallet uses a variety of security features to protect your funds.
* Convenience: GEA Wallet makes it easy to store, send, and receive cryptocurrencies.
* Control: GEA Wallet gives you complete control over your crypto assets.
* Privacy: GEA Wallet allows you to make payments without revealing your personal information.
* Low fees: GEA Wallet typically charges low fees for transactions.
Overall, GEA Wallet is a secure and convenient way to manage your crypto assets.

android.summary:

NEW! BUY, SELL & HOLD CRYPTO
• First national chartered bank where individuals can buy, sell, and hold cryptocurrency.
• Access Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, plus 25+ cryptocurrencies on a platform with the safeguards of a bank.
• Make instant cryptocurrency trades with funds from your SoFi account.

NEW! SOFI SMART CARD
• Charge card secured by SoFi Checking and Savings to simplify payments.
• Purchases automatically set aside in real time. Pay in full monthly with optional autopay.
• On-time payments could help grow your credit score with no revolving debt.

MOBILE BANKING
• Open a checking account with no account fees, no minimum balance, and no hidden charges.
• Get paid up to 2 days early with direct deposit and early payday.²
• Send money, transfer funds, pay bills online, and manage your finances all from one banking app.

STOCK TRADING & INVESTING
• Trade stocks and ETFs with no commission through SoFi Securities (other fees apply).
• Invest in fractional shares starting at just $5 to build your stock portfolio (restrictions apply).
• Automated investing with digital portfolio management from SoFi Wealth.

HIGH-YIELD SAVINGS ACCOUNT
• Earn high APY on savings balances.
• Savings Vaults help organize emergency funds and savings goals in one place.
• Instant transfers between checking and savings with no fees anytime.

LOANS & CREDIT SCORE
• Loan rates for debt consolidation, home improvements, and major purchases.
• Track your credit score with regular updates and monitoring tools.
• Pre-qualify for loans without affecting your credit score, and compare rates instantly.

BANK SECURITY & CUSTOMER SUPPORT
• Bank-level encryption protects personal and financial information with fraud alerts.
• Instant notifications for suspicious account activity keep your money safe.

When you open a SoFi Savings Account, SoFi Bank will also automatically open a SoFi Checking Account in your name. See the SoFi Bank Deposit Account Agreement for details.

SoFi Relay offers users the ability to connect both SoFi accounts and external accounts using Plaid, Inc.’s service and for SoFi to present to you data we have received from the credit bureau. The credit score and associated data provided to you is a VantageScore® based on TransUnion® (the “Processing Agent”) data

²Early access to direct deposit funds is based on the timing in which we receive notice of impending payment from the Federal Reserve, which is typically up to two days before the scheduled payment date, but may vary.

We do not charge any account, service or maintenance fees for SoFi Checking and Savings. We do charge a transaction fee to process each outgoing wire transfer. SoFi does not charge a fee for incoming wire transfers, however the sending bank may charge a fee. Our fee policy is subject to change at any time. See the SoFi Checking & Savings Fee Sheet for details at sofi.com/legal/banking-fees/.

9x based on FDIC monthly savings account rate as of October 20, 2025.

Store of value

Just like Bitcoin - Nexa is equivalent of energy and being used as store of value, and as native Nexa blockchain coin. We have the very same tokenomics and halvings each and every 1,050,000 blocks and halving rewards being cut in the half. Possibilities are beyond infinite.

Global capacity

Thanks to Nexa’s unique PoW algorithm, Nexa will scale to over 10 billion transactions per day. That’s enough capacity for the whole planet. All sensitive operations, including key generation, signing, and storage, are completed locally on the user’s device without external transmission. ChainX Vault also follows a zero data collection policy. It does not gather personal information, behavioral data, seed phrases, or private keys, ensuring that users retain exclusive control of their assets and privacy.

Whether you are new to blockchain or an experienced user, ChainX Vault offers a trustworthy environment for exploring the decentralized world. Beginners will find an intuitive interface that makes it simple to get started, while advanced users will appreciate integrated cross-chain swap access and the ability to connect seamlessly with Web3 applications.

The world needs NFTs to ensure that artwork has only one official owner and that the token's history can be tracked transparently.

What are NFTs?
NFTs are tokens that we can use to represent ownership of unique items. They let us tokenize art, collectibles, and even real estate. They can only have one official owner at a time, and the Ethereum blockchain secures them – no one can modify the record of ownership or copy/paste a new NFT into existence.
NFT stands for non-fungible token. Non-fungible is an economic term that you could use to describe your furniture, a song file, or your computer. These things are not interchangeable with other items because they have unique properties.

android.title: Learn Blockchain Programming
android.summary: Learn Blockchain Cryptocurrency Programming.
android.fullDescription:
Blockchain?
A blockchain is a distributed database that is shared among the nodes of a computer network. As a database, a blockchain stores information electronically in digital format. Blockchains are best known for their crucial role in cryptocurrency systems, such as Bitcoin, for maintaining a secure and decentralized record of transactions. The innovation with a blockchain is that it guarantees the fidelity and security of a record of data and generates trust without the need for a trusted third party.

Cryptocurrency
A cryptocurrency is a digital or virtual currency that is secured by cryptography, which makes it nearly impossible to counterfeit or double-spend. Many cryptocurrencies are decentralized networks based on blockchain technology—a distributed ledger enforced by a disparate network of computers. A defining feature of cryptocurrencies is that they are generally not issued by any central authority, rendering them theoretically immune to government interference or manipulation.

Cryptocurreny are digital or virtual currencies underpinned by cryptographic systems. They enable secure online payments without the use of third-party intermediaries. "Crypto" refers to the various encryption algorithms and cryptographic techniques that safeguard these entries, such as elliptical curve encryption, public-private key pairs, and hashing functions.

A blockchain is essentially a digital ledger of transactions that is duplicated and distributed across the entire network of computer systems on the blockchain. Each block in the chain contains a number of transactions, and every time a new transaction occurs on the blockchain, a record of that transaction is added to every participant’s ledger. The decentralised database managed by multiple participants is known as Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT).

Business runs on information. The faster it’s received and the more accurate it is, the better. Blockchain is ideal for delivering that information because it provides immediate, shared and completely transparent information stored on an immutable ledger that can be accessed only by permissioned network members. A blockchain network can track orders, payments, accounts, production and much more. And because members share a single view of the truth, you can see all details of a transaction end to end, giving you greater confidence, as well as new efficiencies and opportunities.

A cryptocurrency is a medium of exchange that is digital, encrypted and decentralized. Unlike the U.S. Dollar or the Euro, there is no central authority that manages and maintains the value of a cryptocurrency. Instead, these tasks are broadly distributed among a cryptocurrency’s users via the internet.

If you're preparing for an interview in Blockchain Programming, you must use the "Learn Blockchain - Cryptocurrency Programming" to improve your blockchain programming skills. You will have exposure to blockchain interview questions and also other tips to help you crack a blockchain programming interview. The app also includes some live blockchain related apps to help you build blockchain or crypto apps from scratch.

Bitcoin
Bitcoin is a decentralized digital currency created in January 2009. It follows the ideas set out in a white paper by the mysterious and pseudonymous Satoshi Nakamoto. The identity of the person or persons who created the technology is still a mystery.

Bitcoin offers the promise of lower transaction fees than traditional online payment mechanisms do, and unlike government-issued currencies, it is operated by a decentralized authority.

iphone.title: RuieBit: Bitcoin Wallet - BTC
iphone.description:
RuieBit: Bitcoin Wallet - BTC

RuieBit is the ultimate Bitcoin-only wallet — secure, private, and packed with every feature you need to manage BTC your way.
Whether you’re a beginner or an advanced Bitcoiner, RuieBit gives you total control with true self-custody.

— Complete Self-Custody Security

Your keys, your Bitcoin — always stored on your device.

Passcode and biometric security.

Full wallet backup and recovery with clear step-by-step flow.

Replace-by-Fee (RBF) support: adjust fees on pending transactions.

Cancel unconfirmed transactions when needed.

Option to export and securely store recovery phrases.


— Advanced Bitcoin Standards

RuieBit supports all Bitcoin address types and standards, giving you unmatched flexibility:

Taproot (Bech32m / P2TR) — next-generation privacy and efficiency.

SegWit (Bech32 / P2WPKH, P2WSH) — faster, cheaper, and more efficient transactions.

Legacy (P2PKH, P2SH) — full backward compatibility with older wallets.

Wallet imports — recover or import wallets with xPub, private keys, or recovery phrases.

Custom derivation paths supported for advanced use cases.

— Multisig & Professional Wallet Tools

Create and manage multi-signature wallets with ease.

Combine single-sig and multisig wallets in one place.

Import signatures for flexible setups.

View derivation paths, extended public keys (xPub / zPub / yPub), and address sets.

UTXO (Unspent Transaction Outputs) management for advanced control.

Track confirmed and unconfirmed balances at a glance.

— Global Features

Multi-language support: Choose from a wide selection of languages for a truly global wallet.

Multi-currency support: Display balances in BTC, SATS, or convert to your local fiat currency.

Real-time Bitcoin price tracking with instant updates.

— Modern Experience

Light & Dark Modes — pick your style.

Auto theme that adapts to your system settings.

Clean, minimal design focused on usability and clarity.

— Full Transparency & Power

View all wallet details including balances, addresses, UTXOs, and transaction count.

Monitor confirmed and unconfirmed transactions with full mempool visibility.

Export wallet details or addresses when needed.

Complete control over sending and receiving BTC with QR support.

— Extra Features for Power Users

Full derivation path control (BIP32, BIP44, BIP49, BIP84, BIP86).

Address labeling for easy tracking.

Multiple wallets management with flexible organization.

Importing watch-only wallets for monitoring without private keys.

Recovery phrase export and verification tools.

Unlike other wallets, RuieBit is Bitcoin-only. That means:

No altcoins.

No distractions.

No third-party custody.

Just Bitcoin, done right.

Secure self-custody wallet.
Taproot, SegWit, Legacy, Bech32 support.
Multisig & multiple wallets.
Replace-by-Fee (RBF) & transaction cancel.
Multi-language & multi-currency.
Advanced wallet management tools.
Backup & recovery with best practices.
Light, Dark & Auto themes.
UTXO and address-level control.

iphone.title: Cove: Simple Bitcoin Wallet
iphone.description:
Simple, but feature-packed
Cove is the easy-to-use Bitcoin wallet that scales from your first satoshi to advanced coin management – all while keeping your keys where they belong: with you.

Why Cove?
	•	One-tap hot wallets – Create a wallet in seconds. Your private keys are encrypted and stored locally, secured by Face ID / Touch ID and a PIN you control.
	•	Hardware-wallet ready – Bring your Coldcard, TAPSIGNER, Krux and more. Cove speaks PSBT and seamlessly signs via QR (BBQr) or NFC.
	•	Full UTXO control – Select, label and track coins with BIP329 compatibility so your labels stay in sync with desktop wallets like Sparrow.
	•	Decoy & Wipe PINs – Enter a special PIN to reveal a minimal “decoy” wallet or to securely wipe data if you’re under duress.
	•	Always in style – Beautiful light & dark modes, modern typography and thoughtful animations make using Bitcoin a joy.
	•	Built for you – Choose your fiat currency, point Cove at your favorite Electrum or Esplora node, and toggle advanced features as you grow.
	•	Open & auditable – Powered by the battle-tested Bitcoin Development Kit (BDK) and 100% open-source code for maximum transparency.

Advanced features when you’re ready
	•	Watch only wallet support
	•	Custom fee selection
	•	Coin-control, advanced UTXO search, filter and sort, find and send only the UTXOs you choose
	•	Transaction notes using BIP329 labels & exportable history
	•	Secure backup via BIP39 recovery phrase verification workflow
	•	Optional trick-pins, including wipe and decoy PINs

Whether you’re stacking for the first time or an advanced user, Cove lets you use Bitcoin your way—no compromises.

Security at every turn

Cove never touches your seed or sees your private keys. All sensitive operations run 100% on-device, backed by Apple’s Secure Enclave whenever available. Review the source, build it yourself, or just enjoy peace of mind knowing the code is open for anyone to audit.

Get started today
	1.	Download Cove and create a hot wallet (takes ~30 seconds).
	2.	Verify your recovery words and set a PIN.
	3.	Send, receive or connect your hardware wallet for advanced flows.

Bitcoin, on your terms—simple, secure, and feature-packed. That’s Cove.

---
Support: support@covebitcoinwallet.com
Privacy Policy: covebitcoinwallet.com/privacy
Terms & Conditions: covebitcoinwallet.com/terms
---

iphone.title: Bitcoin Cash Register
iphone.description:
The Bitcoin Cash Register is a simple and easy to use Point of Sale application that allows you to accept Bitcoin Cash (BCH) payments—with ZERO fees to receive! (The sender pays less than a penny.)

There’s no sign-up process and no account to manage. Just enter either a standard Bitcoin Cash address or an “extended public key” (aka an “xpub”) from your Bitcoin Cash wallet to start accepting instant and secure Bitcoin Cash payments at your business.

The simple interface means less time training employees and troubleshooting technical issues. Just enter the payment amount in your local currency and show the customer the QR code, scannable by all major BCH wallets.

Other features include:
- Employee Friendly Security: settings can only be changed using PIN code, and the app stores no funds itself
- Local Currency Conversion: choose from over 200 fiat currencies for entering payment amounts
- Transaction History: view all past transactions for your book-keeping needs
- Enhanced Privacy: the Bitcoin Cash Register generates a new address for each transaction when provided with an extended public key
- Open Source: anyone can review the source code for this app at https://github.com/Bitcoin-com/bitcoin-cash-merchant-ios

Why accept Bitcoin Cash?
- Say goodbye to credit card fees! Bitcoin Cash costs absolutely nothing to receive
- Customers pay less than a penny in transaction fees to send
- No registration is required to accept BCH. Just download a free, open-source wallet, like the official Bitcoin.com Wallet
- No one can freeze your wallet
- No one can seize your funds
- No one can block your payments

Start accepting Bitcoin Cash using the Bitcoin Cash Register for a superior payment experience!

Why rely on expensive hardware or worry about complex technical terms? With our cloud solution, you can easily start your Bitcoin mining journey.
No mining on your phone. We do not use your device for mining—our remote servers handle the computing power. Simply choose the cloud mining configuration you want, and watch your Bitcoin balance grow in your built-in wallet. Experience the Cutting Edge of the Digital World
Say goodbye to cumbersome Proof-of-Work (PoW) algorithms, high electricity costs, and complex hardware setups. Our platform handles core processes like network difficulty, Bitcoin halving, and mining pool management, allowing you to focus on expanding your digital assets.

iphone.title: BULL BITCOIN
iphone.description: BULL by Bull Bitcoin is a self-custodial Bitcoin wallet for iOS, designed for secure, private, and efficient management of Bitcoin, Lightning, and Liquid Network transactions. Ideal for both everyday payments and long-term storage, it empowers users to get paid, buy Bitcoin, spend Bitcoin, manage wallets, and securely hold assets with ease. Built on cypherpunk principles, BULL prioritizes user sovereignty, open-source transparency, and trustless operation, integrating cutting-edge technologies to make self-custody safer and simpler without compromising privacy or security. From a single BIP39 seed backup, it creates two interoperable wallets: an Instant Payments Wallet on the Liquid Network for seamless daily Lightning transactions and a Secure Bitcoin Wallet for on-chain payments and robust long-term storage.BULL is Bitcoin-only, segwit-native, and optimized for performance, with no clutter or distractions. It leverages cutting-edge technologies like PayJoin, Liquid’s confidential transactions, and atomic transfers to make self-custody accessible and secure while upholding cypherpunk values of privacy, sovereignty, and decentralization. Free and open-source, BULL is the ultimate platform for managing Bitcoin payments and securing assets for the long haul.

iphone.title: Bitcoin Billionaire
iphone.description:
The smash-hit idle clicker where you mine virtual bitcoins to amass a simulated fortune!

Bitcoin Billionaire is an idle mining game that's all about earning virtual bitcoins through fast tapping, smart investments, and cool upgrades. Go from rags to riches as you upgrade and unlock new items and time travel to the distant past and the far future, all without leaving your comfy chair!

In Bitcoin Billionaire you start with almost nothing: a run-down office, a rickety old desk, and a terrible computer. By tapping the screen you can mine virtual bitcoins to slowly increase your wealth. Spend your earnings on fancy things like entertainment centers and priceless works of art, or upgrade your mining equipment to earn more with each tap. If you're smart, you'll use some of those bitcoins to invest in new technologies that help you earn even when you're not playing!

Just when you think you've seen it all, Bitcoin Billionaire sends you hurtling through time and space. Travel to new eras where you'll earn all new upgrades, unlock extra achievements, and experience the thrills of bitcoin mining from a whole new perspective. If you thought tapping was fun in a modern-day office chair, just wait 'til you park your posterior in a finely crafted stone seat from prehistoric times!

Features:
-Upgrade investments to earn bitcoins while offline.
-Grab bonuses from hovering delivery drones.
-Customize your character to mine in style.
-Free holiday updates and extras.
-Adopt a kitty! Or a robot! Or a T-Rex! Or something else!

Bitcoin Billionaire is an idle mining game that's fun for everyone. Seriously, everyone can play it, you don't have to know anything about bitcoins or mining. If you can tap, you can earn, and if you can earn, you can upgrade all of the things. Now quick, sit down and start tapping!

Note: This game is for entertainment purposes only. You do not mine real bitcoins. You will, however, feel like a billionaire when you finally unlock those expensive upgrades.

iphone.title: BitWalk-Earn Bitcoin every day
iphone.description:
BitWalk – A service where you can earn Bitcoin and cryptocurrency for free just by walking every day!

With BitWalk, you can always check the number of Bitcoins you’ve earned, their current market value, and exchange rate.

▼What is BitWalk?
BitWalk is a service that rewards you with free Bitcoin based on the number of steps you walk each day.
It uses Apple HealthKit to accurately track your step count.

▼Why can I get Bitcoin for free?
BitWalk shares a portion of the advertising revenue it receives from advertisers with users in the form of Bitcoin.
That’s why you can earn Bitcoin for free—something you’d normally have to purchase!

▼Is it okay if the Bitcoin price drops?
Bitcoin prices fluctuate constantly, but there’s no need to panic when prices go down.
In fact, that’s the perfect time to keep earning with BitWalk and wait for the value to rise again!

▼What are the benefits of using BitWalk?

You can start earning Bitcoin with zero initial investment!

There’s no risk of losing money while earning Bitcoin!

With the right strategy, you might even gain significant profit!
Note: Currently not supported on iPad.

iphone.title: Turbo ’84: Bitcoin Joyride
iphone.description:
Do you want to earn Bitcoin by playing games? Play Turbo 84 and you are entered into a free to enter prize draw to win a Bitcoin prize!

- HOW TO PLAY -
Drive as fast as you can through this insane lane changing game! Drive through as many obstacles as you can, picking up speed as you go. Players are judged on their Top Speed and Furthest distance driven.

As you drive, collect tokens you find on the road. Use them to buy more cars and upgrade your engine!

- HOW TO EARN BITCOIN -
This game contains a prize draw in which you can win bitcoin/satoshi via a raffle, paid over The Lightning Network. You must be 18 or over to enter the draw.

To enter the draw you collect THNDR Tickets. Each one counts as an entry to the daily draw in which you can win a bitcoin prize. If you win you can cash out instantly to one of these supported Bitcoin wallet apps with 'Lightning Network' support; ZEBEDEE, Wallet of Satoshi, Breez, Blue Wallet, Bitcoin Lightning Wallet and Zeus.

Note: THNDR Tickets are a virtual currency, not a cryptocurrency. They have no monetary value, cannot be purchased nor are they transferable.

The game contains no crypto currency, wallet or related technology. All prizes are paid from THNDR LTD to the winner, upon you tapping the 'claim all' button on the prize screen. THNDR LTD will send the small amounts of Bitcoin winnings (known as satoshi) via The Lightning Network.

Please note: Apple is not a sponsor nor is involved in any way with this prize draw. The promoter is solely responsible for organising the prize draw and providing the prize if won by an eligible entrant. The prizes won are not products of Apple nor are they related to Apple in any way.

iphone.title: Electron Cash
iphone.description:
Electron Cash is a full-featured SPV wallet for Bitcoin Cash.

Electron Cash is "power user friendly". It allows users ultimate control over their bitcoins and over their private keys, and its user interface is friendly enough that it can be used by novices as well.

Electron Cash supports all the major features one would expect from a Bitcoin Cash wallet.  It is the iOS port of the desktop app, which itself is derived from the Electrum wallet for Bitcoin. (So it has good lineage.)

With Electron Cash YOU control your keys -- and thus your bitcoins.

- Control your own private keys. 
- Easily back up your wallet with a mnemonic seed phrase. 
- Enjoy high security without downloading the blockchain or running a full node.

- BENEFITS -

SAFE - Your private keys are encrypted and never leave your device.

FORGIVING - Your funds can be recovered from a secret phrase.

INSTANT ON - Electron Cash is fast, because it uses servers that index the Bitcoin Cash blockchain.

NO LOCK-IN -  You can export your private keys and use them in other Bitcoin Cash clients or wallets.

NO DOWNTIME - Electron Cash servers are decentralized and redundant. Your wallet is never down.

PROOF CHECKING - Electron Cash Wallet verifies all the transactions in your history using SPV.

COLD STORAGE - Keep your private keys offline, and go online with a watching-only wallet.

---

What is an SPV wallet? 

SPV stands for Simplified Payment Verification. It was first described by Satoshi Nakamoto in the original Bitcoin whitepaper. This method allows a wallet to provide strong security without the need for downloading the blockchain or running a full node. SPV lets you validate your own transactions by ensuring they are confirmed in the blockchain. It uses the best header chain with the most cumulative proof of work and the correct hashing difficulty level. Electron Cash relies on a distributed network of servers which handle the heaviest part of blockchain operations. Your private keys sign transactions locally. They are never sent to the servers.

iphone.title: CoinATMRadar - Bitcoin ATM Map
iphone.description:
Best and easy to use app to find where to exchange cash to crypto and crypto to cash (many coins are listed: Bitcoin, Bitcoin Cash, Litecoin, Ether, Dash, Monero, ZCash, Tether, Ripple etc).

- address
- fees
- limits
- pictures and more.

iphone.title: Clinch PvP Bitcoin Games
iphone.description:
Clinch is a PvP skill-based gaming platform where you can win real money playing a suite of games.

Play head-to-head in two fast-paced competitive games: a Blocks-style puzzle and classic Solitaire!

Win real cash (Bitcoin or dollars) by competing in skill-based matches against opponents from around the world!

 - Instant, automatic cash-outs after every match
 - No deposits required
 - Quick 6-minute matches mean faster winnings
 - Real Bitcoin and cash rewards


Don’t believe it? Join the Clinch Telegram for proof. Forget empty promises - there are no thresholds and no delays, just instant payouts!

Play, win, and watch your money land in your account immediately!


NO DEPOSITS & INSTANT PAYMENTS
Tired of promises of quick payouts, only to wait months for your funds from other games? Not with Clinch! Play a game, win, and get your funds instantly — not in hours or days!


SKILL-BASED MATCHMAKING
Compete with players of a similar skill level. Both players are dealt the exact hand of cards or blocks sequence, ensuring a fair, skill-based game. There are no bots or fake accounts to create an illusion of winning. And there are no difficulty changes near withdrawal limits!

NO TIME-BASED SCORING
Have you ever finished a game quickly and earned a time bonus, only to find out your opponent finished even faster? In Clinch, there’s no extra points for finishing early. Play at your own pace, enjoy, and relax with a fair game!

GETTING STARTED
Download the game for FREE, then simply connect your wallet! Each game’s entry fee is paid separately, eliminating the need to deposit more than you want to play! Best of all, winnings are instantly and automatically paid out to your wallet.

SOLITAIRE - HOW TO PLAY
Draw cards from the deck and play them into position to build up each foundation, in sequence and in suit, from Ace to King. Build the entire card deck onto the foundations, and if done successfully, you’ve completed the Solitaire deck!

BLOCKS - HOW TO PLAY
Place block shapes on the board and create lines of 9 blocks or 3x3 squares in designated areas to clear blocks and earn points. Survive until the final round and earn extra points for shapes on the map. Remember to collect extra points from the map grid!

MATCHES
Clinch is a skill-based game where two players receive the same game setup, play by the same rules, and must finish the match in the same amount of time. Only skill matters! The player with the highest score wins.

USE ANY WALLET
Challenge competitors around the world for real Bitcoin and cash prizes. Use a Lightning-enabled Bitcoin wallet like Coinbase, Speed, Strike, ZEBEDEE, Wallet of Satoshi, or others to make payments. When it’s time to pay, you’ll be prompted to do so using your external wallet.

Please note: Prize-earning games are not available in all countries. In the USA, they are disabled in the following states: AR, CT, DE, IN, LA, ME, and SD. Players must be at least 18 years of age.

If you have any questions, feel free to reach us at:
help@thndr.games

Privacy Policy: https://clinch.gg/legal/privacy
Terms of Use: https://clinch.gg/legal/terms-and-conditions

iphone.title: Bitcoin Blast
iphone.description:
Put your color-matching skills to the test with the Blingiest, most rewarding match-3 game on the market! Bitcoin Blast combines your love of crypto with your need for brain-stimulating puzzles.  

Blast your way through hundreds of strategic levels with progressive difficulty. Focus on creating colorful combos--the longer the Bitcoin chain the bigger the explosions! Collect diamonds/rubies, shatter stones, and crack the safes by matching the “Bitcoin” with like-colored coins.  

Each level creates a unique opportunity for you test your puzzle-solving skills. Make sure to think ahead as moves you make now can affect the outcome of level; keep your eye on the timer as some levels give you less time to think. Make longer chains to score higher star values.  

Use long chains in combination with epic powerups to get the most bang out of your BTC. Crack the Bitcoin and earn Bling Points in-app if you log into your Bling account.  

Features:  
Hundreds of Levels 
Solve Strategic Puzzles  
Test Your Skills With Progressive Difficulty 
Create Colorful Combos  
Bitcoin Themed

iphone.title: Bitcoin Sim
iphone.description:
Bitcoin Sim lets you time-travel through Bitcoin’s possible futures—anything from next quarter to 2045—using lightning-fast, customizable Monte Carlo simulations. Move a slider, flip a toggle, or add a liquidity shock and watch thousands of price paths fan out on a Metal-powered chart. Every scenario is purely hypothetical, so you can experiment freely with zero real-money risk.

Highlights
• GPU Turbo – Up to 300 000 iterations in ~20 s (≈ 11× faster than CPU).
• Guided Walk-through – A step-by-step overlay gets first-time users running and interpreting results in minutes.
• Tilt Bar – A live, green-to-red meter shows how bullish or bearish your current settings are.
• Portfolio Planner – Add a lump sum, schedule DCA buys, or set withdrawals to test any strategy.
• Seed Lock (IAP) – Freeze the random seed for perfectly repeatable A/B comparisons.
• Deep-Dive Models – Mean reversion, regime switching, GARCH volatility, and autocorrelation for serious quants.
• Risk Dashboard – Flip the summary card for Sortino Ratio, Max Drawdown, and Value-at-Risk.
• Insights Generator – After every run, you get a clear, plain-English write-up that spotlights the key drivers behind your outcome.
• Fluid Metal Charts – Pinch, pan, and toggle between BTC price and portfolio value on a log scale.
• Learn as You Go – Clear tooltips translate complex math into everyday language.

Whether you’re brand-new to crypto or a data-driven HODLer, Bitcoin Sim gives you the sandbox to imagine where Bitcoin could go—right from your iPhone or iPad.

iphone.description:
Tired of missing out on crypto price movements? Download the Bitcoin & Crypto Price Widget to follow the prices of your favorite coins from your home screen, lock screen (iOS 16+ required) or Apple Watch!


The Bitcoin & Crypto Price Widget enables you to keep up with over 400 of the world’s most popular coins, including Ethereum (ETH), Ripple (XRP) and Dogecoin (DOGE), 24 hours a day, seven days a week.


Its powerful, dynamic interface displays market data in a clear, easy-to-read way. Want to see even more? Simply widen your widget to get a complete overview of what’s happening in the markets.


What's more, you can now track the price of your chosen crypto and coins online on your locked iPhone screen (iOS 16+ required).


You can customize your widget to suit your needs and track crypto prices on your Apple Watch. Select your local currency, choose your favorite coins, and set a background and font that’s as simple or fancy as you like.


Never miss big market moves again. Download the Bitcoin & Crypto Price Widget today.


How to use the widget on your iOS device:


1) Download the app
2) Open the app, select a widget, and customize it to your preferences
3) Go back to your home screen and tap and hold an empty area until all your apps shake
4) Tap the ‘+’ button in the upper right corner

iphone.title: ChainX Vault: Bitcoin Wallet
iphone.description:
ChainX Vault is a decentralized non-custodial multi-chain wallet designed for the new era of Web3 users. It provides a secure and independent environment for digital asset management and blockchain interaction. Supporting BTC, ETH, BNB Chain, TRON, DOGE, Solana, and other major networks, it integrates third-party cross-chain swaps powered by decentralized protocols, and includes a Web3 browser entry that allows users to explore DeFi, NFT, GameFi, and other decentralized applications.

Unlike custodial wallets or exchanges, ChainX Vault is built with a strict non-custodial architecture. Private keys are generated and stored locally on the user’s device, ensuring that assets are always under the user’s full control. All transactions are signed directly by the user, and the app never holds or manages funds on behalf of anyone. This guarantees complete independence and eliminates the risks associated with centralized custody.

ChainX Vault is not an exchange and does not provide virtual asset trading, fiat conversion, or investment services. All swap functions are performed through third-party decentralized protocols, and all Web3 interactions are handled via external DApps. The app itself is purely a tool—an interface that empowers users to manage their own assets and access decentralized services in a secure and transparent way.

Security and privacy are fundamental principles of ChainX Vault. The wallet adopts a quantum-resistant (anti-quantum) encryption architecture, protecting against present and future threats, including those posed by quantum computing. All sensitive operations, including key generation, signing, and storage, are completed locally on the user’s device without external transmission. ChainX Vault also follows a zero data collection policy. It does not gather personal information, behavioral data, seed phrases, or private keys, ensuring that users retain exclusive control of their assets and privacy.

Whether you are new to blockchain or an experienced user, ChainX Vault offers a trustworthy environment for exploring the decentralized world. Beginners will find an intuitive interface that makes it simple to get started, while advanced users will appreciate integrated cross-chain swap access and the ability to connect seamlessly with Web3 applications.

ChainX Vault is more than just a wallet—it is your secure gateway to Web3. With non-custodial independence, future-proof encryption, and uncompromising privacy, it gives you the freedom to manage assets across blockchains and interact with decentralized applications without relying on intermediaries.

ChainX Vault — a secure, independent, and trustworthy non-custodial multi-chain wallet, built as a tool for exploring the decentralized future.

Send, receive, and store all your digital assets in one easy-to-use Web3 wallet. As a non custodial wallet, your crypto and private keys are entirely under your control.  Omni features best-in-class encryption, biometric authentication, and a unique 12-word secret phrase for added security. 
The app is not just for storage, but it’s also your gateway to Web3. Explore dApps, DeFi protocols, and DAOs, and discover new projects from a single multichain wallet.

MULTI-CHAIN SUPPORT
Say goodbye to juggling a different wallet for each blockchain.  Securely store 10,000 coins and tokens from an ever-growing list of supported Layer 1 and Layer 2 networks, including:
- Akash
- Arbitrum
- Avalanche C Chain
- Binance Smart Chain
- Celo
- Cosmos
- Ethereum
- Fantom

- Harmony

- Sushi
- Tezos
- The Graph

Move coins, tokens, and NFTs easily to external Web3 wallets with no extra fees (network fees still apply).

SWAP, BRIDGE, GO
Swap tokens natively and bridge across major EVM-compatible networks and leading Layer 2s.

STORE AND MANAGE NFTS
Manage your collection and even personalize your NFT wallet by setting your collectibles as your wallpaper and avatar. Omni is compatible with NFTs from Ethereum, Solana, and other blockchains.

No complex setup needed to import all of your existing crypto wallets and funds from MetaMask, Phantom, Rainbow, and other platforms.

HARDWARE CRYPTO WALLET COMPATIBILITY
Want to move your digital assets offline? Omni is the solution. Simply sync your Ledger with the Omni non custodial wallet and transfer your crypto to cold storage.

MULTILINGUAL SUPPORT
The Omni multichain wallet can be accessed in six different languages, with more coming: 
English
Chinese
Turkish
Spanish
Vietnamese
Korean
Thai

24/7 CUSTOMER SERVICE
For feedback or feature requests, email us at support@omni.app or on X/Twitter at @omnidotapp. Our (human) reps will get back to you as soon as possible.

iphone.title: 1inch: DeFi Crypto Wallet
iphone.description:
1inch Wallet is a self-custodial crypto wallet that puts you in control of your onchain assets. Manage and secure crypto across chains from Ethereum and Solana to Base and beyond. 

Why use 1inch Wallet?
• Maximize security with scam protection, biometric access, Ledger integration and more features.
• Use your crypto wallet across 13 networks: Ethereum, Solana, Base, Sonic, BNB Chain, Arbitrum, Polygon and more
• Enjoy DeFi wallet support for USDT, USDC, ETH, BNB, Wrapped Bitcoin and other tokens, plus memecoins and RWAs
• Track your onchain asset performance with PnL statistics for every token, and explore Web3 with the built-in browser.

Protect your crypto with confidence
• Get scam protection for tokens, addresses, transactions and domains
• Stay informed on every transaction with Clear Signing for transparency

• Save time with reusable transaction templates

Whatever you’re holding, 1inch Wallet is the blockchain wallet that adapts to your needs. With self-custody and reliable backups, your assets stay protected at all times. Whatever you do in DeFi, do it with 1inch Wallet, your secure crypto wallet app.

iphone.title: HashPort Wallet
iphone.description:
The wallet app used by one million visitors at the Osaka–Kansai Expo is now renewed!

HashPort Wallet is a Web3 wallet that even beginners can use with confidence.
Manage and utilize your digital assets smartly — start for free today!

The “EXPO2025 Digital Wallet”, the official wallet app of the Osaka–Kansai Expo, has been renewed as a new service called “HashPort Wallet”, which can continue to be used even after the Expo ends!
All your existing assets, NFTs, and SBTs (*1) can be carried over as they are, and now the app also supports the stablecoin USDC (*2).
This wallet app supports everything from daily point utilization to the future of digital asset management.

Main Features of HashPort Wallet
■ Easy migration and registration

Existing users can continue using the app simply by updating it.
New users can complete registration within a few minutes.

■ Supports the global stablecoin USDC

Supports USDC, a globally recognized stablecoin backed 1:1 by the U.S. dollar.

■ Supports a wide range of digital assets (multi-chain support)

In addition to Ethereum, Polygon, Aptos, and Base, popular chains such as Bitcoin, BNB Chain, Avalanche, and Arbitrum will be gradually added in the future.

■ Supports over 120 types of currencies

Morpho Token (Base Mainnet)

■ Access to decentralized exchanges

You can connect to decentralized finance (DeFi) services, including decentralized exchanges (DEX *3), which allow you to seamlessly swap your digital assets for other currencies.

■ Exchange points for digital assets (planned)

We plan to link with various domestic point services so that, in the future, users will be able to convert points earned from shopping into digital assets.

■ Manage NFTs and SBTs (carry over Expo digital assets)

You can continue managing the NFTs and SBTs obtained at the Osaka–Kansai Expo.
It’s also easy to receive and send new NFTs.

■ Ongoing special campaigns

Exclusive campaigns for users will be held regularly.
For the latest updates, please visit our official website:
https://wallet.hashport.com/

Recommended for:

Those who want to keep NFTs obtained with the EXPO2025 Digital Wallet as memories

Those who want to earn digital assets through events

Those who want to make better use of everyday points as digital assets

From beginners to advanced users — everyone can enjoy using this wallet.

Glossary

(*1) NFT / SBT:
NFTs are tokens that give digital data uniqueness.
SBTs are non-transferable tokens that certify personal activities or achievements.

(*2) USDC (USD Coin):
A stablecoin pegged 1:1 to the U.S. dollar, issued by Circle in the United States and widely used worldwide.

(*3) DEX (Decentralized Exchange):
A mechanism that allows digital assets to be exchanged without an intermediary or central administrator.

iphone.title: Dash Wallet
iphone.description:
Dash Wallet is the first iPhone wallet for Dash - Digital Cash - a better innovative alternative to bitcoin which is focused on payments.

Dash is a cryptocurrency that seeks to fix the flaws that other cryptocurrencies suffer from. It relies on a network of Masternodes to allow such things as instant transactions, optional privacy features, and a direct funding mechanism to kickstart innovative ideas.

Intuitive and secure, Dash Wallet gives you complete control over your digital cash. Send and receive Dash payments instantly, with the safest mobile wallet available.

Dash Wallet is the first and only iPhone wallet that connects directly to the Dash network. This means that there are no servers to get hacked or go down - your funds are always safe. Even if your phone is lost, damaged or stolen, you can easily recover your funds using your personal recovery phrase.

Features:

* Send and receive Dash payments in seconds, online or in-person
* One button payments to Dash-accepting merchants and websites
* Pay quickly with Face ID recognition
* Sweeping of paper wallets (e.g. those used for cold storage)
* 3rd party integrations to allow users to buy and sell Dash
* Simple recovery phrase enables you to recover funds when your device is lost or broken
* Flexible settings to meet a range of custom security preferences
* Direct Dash network client - no central server to get hacked or go down

Dash Wallet is open source and free. There are no extra transaction fees or costs. Send any amount of money to anyone in the world instantly. This is how money should be.

iphone.title: Hextron: Mine BTC, DOGE, XBTC
iphone.description:
Hextron is not a crypto trading or exchange app - you can’t buy, sell, swap, or trade in the app. Hextron is a crypto mining-management dashboard that displays off-site mining outputs and contract status.

What Hextron does

Real off-site mining: Monitor BTC, DOGE, XBTC, Kaspa and more from Hextron facilities in Texas, Bahrain, and Sarawak, Malaysia.

Read-only wallet display: After you activate a plan outside the app, Hextron’s backend auto-provisions a wallet for display only (no send/receive, no key custody).

Dashboard only: View balances, daily accruals, and logs. The iOS app performs no transfers or trades.

Payout requests: Submit a request to withdraw earned rewards; processing occurs on Hextron servers (typical timeframe 5–7 business days). No transfers happen in-app.

Referral tracking: See commissions/overrides from your network (display only).

Security: KYC, 2FA, and internal fraud checks protect your account.

Important

No on-device mining.

No in-app purchases of mining plans (plans are activated externally).

No exchange or conversion features in the iOS app.

iphone.title: Arculus Wallet
iphone.description:
Arculus is the next-gen crypto and NFT cold storage wallet solution. The Arculus Wallet App lets you securely hold the world’s leading cryptocurrencies and NFTs. Arculus features an easy-to-use mobile app and a sleek, metal card where you store and control your private keys. Arculus was created by CompoSecure, a 20-year leader in security, payment, and digital-asset storage technology solutions. 


HOW ARCULUS WORKS
Your Arculus wallet solution is made up of two parts that work together: a physical Arculus Key™ Card and the mobile Arculus Wallet™ App. The Arculus Key Card is a sleek, metal card with leading-edge embedded security technology, a CC EAL6+ Secure Element Hardware Classification, to securely store your crypto and NFT keys. The card can be purchased at the Arculus website – getarculus.com.


Your Arculus wallet protects your digital assets with 3-factor authentication relying on something you are (a biometric marker), something you know (a PIN), and something you have (your Arculus Key Card).

Arculus has no cables, no Bluetooth, or USB connections and it never needs to be charged. It’s true cold storage. Your private keys are stored on the card and are always in your possession.

With Arculus, you don’t have to toggle between screens or push tiny buttons on a USB drive. Just enter your PIN and tap your card to the back of your phone.

It’s digital asset security made simple.

iphone.title: Status: Ethereum Crypto Wallet
iphone.description:
Status combines pseudonymous privacy-focused messenger and secure crypto wallet into one powerful communication tool. Chat with friends and growing communities. Buy, store, and exchange digital assets.

Status is your Ethereum operating system.

SECURE ETHEREUM WALLET
The Status crypto wallet allows you to securely send, store, and exchange Ethereum assets such as ETH, SNT, stable coins such as DAI, as well as collectibles. Confidently take control of your cryptocurrency and digital assets with our multichain Ethereum wallet app, supporting Ethereum Mainnet, Base, Arbitrum, and Optimism. The Status blockchain wallet currently only supports ETH, ERC-20, ERC-721, and ERC-1155 assets; it does not support Bitcoin.

PRIVATE MESSENGER
Send private 1:1 and private group chats without anyone snooping on your communications. Status is a messenger app that eliminates centralised message relays for greater privacy and secure messaging. All messages are encrypted with end-to-end encryption. Additionally, no message exposes who the author or the intended recipient is, so nobody, not even Status, knows who is talking to who or what was said.

EARN WITH DEFI
Put your crypto to work with the latest decentralised finance apps and decentralised exchanges (DEX) such as Maker, Aave, Uniswap, Synthetix, PoolTogether, Zerion, Kyber, and more.

CONNECT WITH YOUR COMMUNITY
Explore, connect, and chat with your favourite communities and friends. Whether it is a small group of friends, an artist collective, crypto traders, or the next big organization - text and communicate with Status communities.

PRIVATE ACCOUNT CREATION
Stay private with pseudo-anonymous account creation. When creating your free account, you will NEVER have to enter a phone number, email address, or bank account. Your wallet private keys are locally generated and securely stored to ensure only you have access to your funds and financial transactions.

iphone.title: R2 Wallet: DROIB Project
iphone.description:
R2 Wallet App – Your Secure, Non-Custodial Wallet for DROIB Tokens

Welcome to R2 Wallet, the official non-custodial digital wallet for the EU-trademarked DROIB Project, developed by Serenity 3D ApS. Designed for simplicity and security, R2 Wallet puts you in complete control of your digital assets.

Key Features:

Non-Custodial Control: R2 Wallet is a self-custody wallet, meaning you alone control your cryptographic private keys and recovery phrases. Your funds are held directly on the BNB Smart Chain blockchain, and we never have access to them. You are responsible for safeguarding your keys and backups.

Exclusive DROIB Token Support: This app is designed specifically for the DROIB token (BEP-20 standard). Easily send, receive, and view your DROIB token balances.

BNB Gas Fee Visibility: Monitor your BNB (Binance Coin) balance to understand and cover network transaction fees required for DROIB transfers.

Irreversible Transactions: Authorize transactions with confidence. Once confirmed on the blockchain, transfers are final and cannot be reversed. Always verify recipient addresses and amounts carefully.

Optional NFC Tipping Feature: In the future, the app may facilitate convenient peer-to-peer "tipping" of DROIB tokens via Near Field Communication (NFC) for casual, personal transfers. This feature is optional and remains under your control.

Important Usage Limitations – What R2 Wallet Does NOT Do:

R2 Wallet is a wallet interface, not a financial service provider, exchange, or bank.

No Asset Custody by Company: We do not hold your cryptocurrency assets or private keys.

No Crypto Purchases: You cannot buy DROIB or any other tokens with fiat currency (e.g., EUR, USD) directly within the app.

No Token Sales or Distribution: The app does not facilitate ICOs, airdrops, or token sales from the Company.

No Fiat Currency Handling: R2 Wallet does not support fiat currency deposits, withdrawals, or conversions.

No Crypto-to-Crypto Exchange: You cannot trade or swap DROIB for other cryptocurrencies within the app.

No Payment Processing: Aside from the optional peer-to-peer NFC tipping, the app is not a payment service provider for commercial transactions.

No Financial Advice: The app does not provide investment advice or portfolio management services.

A Non-Profit, Community-Driven Project:

The DROIB Project and R2 Wallet are operated by Serenity 3D ApS as a non-profit initiative with limited resources. While we strive for a functional and secure application, updates, bug fixes, and user support may be slower compared to commercial products. You acknowledge and accept the inherent risks of using blockchain software provided by a small, non-profit project.

Your Security is Key:

You are solely responsible for securing your device and wallet credentials. We highly recommend strong device security and secure, offline backups of your recovery seed phrase. Serenity 3D will never ask for your private keys or seed phrase.

Download R2 Wallet now and take control of your DROIB tokens!

iphone.title: Splitcoin - Cold Storage
iphone.description:
"Most people are not able to back up their security keys; they will lose the device. They will not have the proper encryption for their backup; they will write it on a piece of paper, someone else will see it, and they will steal those funds." -Changpeng Zhao, CEO of Binance

Safeguarding seed phrases is a critical yet often neglected aspect of cryptocurrency security. Seed phrases work well, but we need to fortify their storage. Enter Splitcoin: a pioneering seed phrase encryption tool designed for cryptocurrency users who want to self-custody their assets. It empowers users to create a vault for their seed phrase, using an innovative auto-scrolling codebook displayed in the Splitcoin app for manual encryption. This codebook is accessed through a unique vault key, encrypted and distributed across a set of NFC-enabled physical coins or QR codes. Decrypting your seed phrase is as simple as scanning your coins with the app and entering your password. 

The best part? The Splitcoin app will never know your seed phrase or ask you for it.

The brilliance of Splitcoin lies in its adherence to seed phrase storage best practices:
1. Never share your seed phrase with anyone.
2. Never store your seed phrase online.
3. Never enter your seed phrase into a device that is not a hardware wallet.

Splitcoin fortifies seed phrase storage with the following features:
• Secret Key Splitting: Splitcoin splits a secret key, termed the vault key, across multiple physical devices known as Splitcoins. This distribution of the key adds a strong layer of physical security, mitigating the risk of seed phrase theft. Each coin contains an encrypted key shard required to access your codebook for decryption. 
• Manual Encryption: Utilizing the vault key, Splitcoin generates an auto-scrolling codebook within its mobile application. This codebook allows users to manually encrypt and decrypt their seed phrases securely. Each page of the codebook acts as an independent cipher to securely encrypt your seed phrase.
• User Empowerment: Splitcoin places control firmly in the hands of the user, requiring both physical possession of the Splitcoins and knowledge of the password to decrypt the encrypted seed phrase. By enabling manual encryption of seed phrases, Splitcoin ensures that your seed phrase will never be digitally stored or shared with our app. The Splitcoin app doesn't want to know it and will never ask for it. Users gain the confidence to protect their seed phrase, because they don't share any aspect of their private key with our technology.
• Simplicity and Accessibility: The manual encryption process, guided by the auto-scrolling codebook, is straightforward, eliminating the need for complex technological interactions or cryptographic understanding. Simply put, Splitcoin is a world-class UX for users of all technical abilities.
• Backups and Alternative Storage: The Splitcoin app makes it easy to make backups, giving you a few different options. Using Splitcoin Tools, you can copy your coins onto other NFC tags, export them as QR codes, or export your codebook as a PDF - in case you never want to use the Splitcoin app again!

Splitcoin acknowledges the inherent risks in traditional seed phrase storage methods and offers a secure, user-centric alternative that is already compatible with every crypto wallet on the market. Why introduce more pain points to self-custody when we could just solve the current ones? There is no need to reinvent the wheel - or in this case, reinvent seed phrases. Simply fortify them with Splitcoin.

Learn more at www.splitcoin.com.

iphone.title: Fuse - Solana Smart Wallet
iphone.description:
Fuse is Solana's first smart wallet, designed to leverage smart accounts to redefine personal digital asset management. Fuse is not an iteration of existing crypto wallets; it’s a reimagination of what a crypto wallet can be, meticulously built to support the evolving needs of digital asset management.

Fuse is built on Solana’s leading smart account standard—Squads Protocol—to create the most secure wallet for your Solana assets. Fuse replaces seed phrases and single-key pairs with multifactor authentication. Each Fuse wallet deploys a smart account that requires approval from 2 out of 3 designated keys for every transaction. This multisig configuration removes any single point of failure and makes it much harder for unauthorized access to your funds. Fuse’s programmability also lets you rotate keys and enables social recovery, giving you more control and peace of mind.

Smart accounts move the industry forward from a one-size-fits-all custody model to one based on programmability and customization. Apart from making wallet access and recovery more seamless, Fuse also unlocks new workflows:

- Progressive Security: Start with a simple email for wallet recovery and elevate your security over time. Whether it's integrating a cold wallet as a 2FA mechanism or the flexibility to rotate keys, Fuse adapts to your security needs. 

- Spending Limits: Define spending limits for any token and timeframe. Spending limits enable transactions without multifactor authentication for predefined operations, blending convenience with control.

- Gas Abstraction: Fuse acts as a “gas tank” that automatically pays network fees on your behalf, ensuring a seamless transaction experience at all times.

We created Fuse with the belief that robust asset security is crucial for the growth of the onchain economy. 
We aim to be the premier platform for growing your onchain wealth securely. Try Fuse today.

Fuse is Solana's first smart wallet, designed to leverage smart accounts to redefine personal digital asset management. Fuse is not an iteration of existing crypto wallets; it’s a reimagination of what a crypto wallet can be, meticulously built to support the evolving needs of digital asset management.

Fuse is built on Solana’s leading smart account standard—Squads Protocol—to create the most secure wallet for your Solana assets. Fuse replaces seed phrases and single-key pairs with multifactor authentication. Each Fuse wallet deploys a smart account that requires approval from 2 out of 3 designated keys for every transaction. This multisig configuration removes any single point of failure and makes it much harder for unauthorized access to your funds. Fuse’s programmability also lets you rotate keys and enables social recovery, giving you more control and peace of mind.

Smart accounts move the industry forward from a one-size-fits-all custody model to one based on programmability and customization. Apart from making wallet access and recovery more seamless, Fuse also unlocks new workflows:

- Progressive Security: Start with a simple email for wallet recovery and elevate your security over time. Whether it's integrating a cold wallet as a 2FA mechanism or the flexibility to rotate keys, Fuse adapts to your security needs. 

- Spending Limits: Define spending limits for any token and timeframe. Spending limits enable transactions without multifactor authentication for predefined operations, blending convenience with control.

- Gas Abstraction: Fuse acts as a “gas tank” that automatically pays network fees on your behalf, ensuring a seamless transaction experience at all times.

We created Fuse with the belief that robust asset security is crucial for the growth of the onchain economy. 
We aim to be the premier platform for growing your onchain wealth securely. Try Fuse today.

The Prepaid Debit Visa Card (the “Card”) is issued by Lead Bank, pursuant to licensing by Visa U.S.A. Inc. and may be used everywhere Visa is accepted. Must be 18 or older to apply. Fees may apply. See Cardholder Agreement and Squads Labs Inc. (“Squads”) website for more details. 

Bridge Ventures LLC (“Bridge”) is not a bank. Bridge is a financial technology company and is the Program Manager responsible for managing and operating the Card on behalf of Lead Bank. Squads is not a bank. Squads is a financial technology company and is the Platform Provider responsible for the application, access, and management of/for the card.

iphone.title: Gaya: AI Crypto Wallet
iphone.description:
The all-new Gaya Wallet has been redesigned with an improved interface, upgraded features, and a seamless multichain experience. Whether you’re new to Web3 or an experienced user, Gaya gives you complete control over your assets with advanced tools, flexible management, and rewarding ways to engage.

Create a Wallet with Email or Seed Phrase
Create a wallet using your email or social login with MPC technology for secure, keyless access, or use a seed phrase or private key for full self-custody.

Multiple Wallets and Addresses
Create or import multiple wallets across Solana, XRPL, Tron, and EVM chains. Each wallet can hold multiple addresses for organised and flexible asset management.

Multichain Support
Manage assets seamlessly across Solana, EVM networks, XRPL, and Tron, ensuring smooth cross-chain visibility and interaction.

Send and Receive
Send and receive tokens easily across supported networks with transparency and accurate transaction tracking.

Swaps
Swap tokens within the same network quickly and securely without leaving the wallet.

Multichain Bridge / Cross-Chain Swaps
Move assets across chains effortlessly with built-in multichain bridging. Perform cross-chain swaps directly inside Gaya for a unified, frictionless experience.

Buy and Sell Crypto
Instantly buy or sell crypto with new on/off-ramp integration. Bridging fiat and crypto directly within Gaya for a smoother, more accessible experience.

WalletConnect
Connect Gaya Wallet to any external web or mobile dApp using WalletConnect. Scan the QR code to perform transactions or interact securely with decentralised applications.

Dapp Browser
Explore and interact with decentralised applications directly within the in-app dapp browser, enabling seamless on-chain actions without leaving Gaya.

AI Assistant
Meet your built-in AI crypto companion. Designed to help you understand, manage, and explore Web3 and Gaya with insights, guidance, and real-time support.

Referrals
Invite friends to Gaya and earn XP through the referral system. Build your network and unlock continuous rewards.

Tasks
Complete social quests and on-chain tasks to earn XP. XP can later be converted into $GAYA tokens or used in other modules within the app.

Detailed Token Information
View real-time token prices, interactive charts, transaction histories, and performance metrics across supported tokens.

Transaction History
Access a clear, organised record of all your wallet activity. Transactions can be filtered by network, date/time, and type for ease.

Unique Usernames and Identity
Register a unique Gaya username that links all your wallets across supported chains.

Web3 Explorer
Browse on-chain data across supported networks with a built-in Web3 explorer, allowing easy viewing of transactions, addresses, and contract details.

Language Support
Use Gaya in your preferred language with support for 17 languages, making the wallet accessible to a global audience.
