iphone.title: Zashi: Zcash Wallet
iphone.description:
Developed by the team that continues to set the industry standard for blockchain privacy, the original developers of the Zcash protocol at Electric Coin Company (ECC).

Buy, Spend, and Store Encrypted Electronic Cash
Zashi is a ZEC-only wallet that connects with leading services, providing you with more ways to use ZEC and making it your hub for real-world crypto use.
* Buy ZEC directly in Zashi with the Coinbase integration. If you're in the US, you don’t even need a Coinbase account; just use your debit card.
* Spend shielded ZEC instantly at thousands of merchant locations through Flexa.
* Swap ZEC with supported cryptocurrencies using Near Intents.
* Store shielded ZEC securely using the open-source Keystone hardware wallet.
More integrations are on the way. 

Send Encrypted Messages
Thanks to Zcash’s private memo feature, each shielded transaction, including those with zero value, can include an encrypted note visible only to the recipient. With Zcash’s extremely low gas fees, truly private communication costs pennies.

Self-Custody
Zashi puts users in complete control of their funds: no gatekeepers, no middlemen, just true financial sovereignty. Only you can access and manage your ZEC: your keys, your crypto.

Privacy by Design 
Zashi is a privacy-first wallet. That means having access to as little user data as possible. We do not see, collect, or track user data and wallet activity. Like most apps, Zashi uses crash reports (enabled and generated at the operating system level) to help identify bugs and improve performance. But unlike most apps, even those claiming to prioritize privacy, Zashi doesn’t see or collect any other data, which is rare among app developers.
Crash reports provide limited anonymized technical data, the sole purpose of which is to monitor the app’s health and stability, nothing more.

The Most Sensible Way to Get Started with Crypto
Zashi is designed to make crypto safe, simple, and truly private. With industry-leading privacy and security, an intuitive interface, clear prompts, and integrations that let you buy and use ZEC in the real world, it’s the ideal wallet for anyone just getting started. 

User Feedback
Zashi is shaped by its users. Every update reflects what our community wants most. Whether you're requesting a new feature or sharing a bug report, your voice helps make the wallet better for everyone.

Ongoing Development 
Zashi is actively maintained by a dedicated team committed to privacy, security, and self-sovereignty. New features, integrations, and performance improvements are released regularly.

iphone.title: Voi Wallet
iphone.description:
Voi Wallet is a self-custody mobile wallet built to provide a seamless, secure, and powerful experience on Voi Network, as well as other AVM-compatible (Algorand Virtual Machine) networks such as Algorand.

Key Features
* Security-first design — Your private keys stay on your device.
* Fast transactions — Leverage the speed and affordability of Voi Network transfers.
* Cross-chain / AVM compatibility — Manage and interact with assets and dApps on both Voi Network and Algorand.
* dApp & WalletConnect integration — Connect to your favorite decentralized apps directly through the wallet.
* Hardware wallet / Ledger support — Pair a Ledger devices for extra security
* Account recovery & passphrase support — Restore or manage accounts securely.
* Watch-only & multi-account support — Monitor accounts without exposing keys; maintain multiple wallets.
* Rekey / advanced features — Manage account access and control with advanced crypto features.
* ARC-200 and ARC-72 standards — View and transfer ARC-200 Smart Tokens, and ARC-72 Smart NFTs natively within Voi Wallet
* Initial support for ARC-90 QR Codes
* Air-gapped signing -- Use a secondary offline signing device to keep your private keys safe

Why Choose Voi Wallet?
* Built specifically for the Voi Network, optimized for best experience
* Clean UI and intuitive workflow even for newer users
* Constant updates and improvements
* Backed by a growing ecosystem and community

Voi Wallet is a self-custody wallet. Keys remain on device. Perpetual Software LLC is not a financial institution.

iphone.title: Ethereum Wallet - ETH & Tokens

SELF-CUSTODY WALLET
Your private keys are stored securely on your device and never leave your phone. Create a new wallet in seconds or import an existing one using your seed phrase or private key.

STAKE ETHEREUM
Earn rewards by staking your ETH through Lido liquid staking. View real-time APR, track your stETH balance, and monitor your daily, monthly, and yearly earnings projections. Unstake anytime to convert back to ETH.

Send ETH and ERC-20 tokens to any Ethereum address or ENS name. Scan QR codes to quickly fill recipient addresses. Generate QR codes to receive payments, including specific amount requests. View real-time gas estimates before confirming transactions.

PORTFOLIO TRACKING
Monitor your total portfolio value with real-time price updates. View your asset allocation with an interactive pie chart. Track 24-hour portfolio performance. Pull to refresh for the latest balances and prices.

TRANSACTION HISTORY
View your complete transaction history with detailed information. Filter by date range, transaction type, or status. Track pending transactions and confirmations in real time. See gas fees paid for each transaction.

- Private key export with authentication

iphone.title: CoinEx Vault: Multi-Sig Wallet
iphone.description:
CoinEx Vault is a self-custodial wallet for enterprises and large asset holders, providing enterprise-level cryptocurrency asset security management solutions through the “Multi-signature + Cold Wallet” mode.
CoinEx Vault App takes your offline mobile device as a cold wallet carrier to help you securely store and manage multi-chain cryptocurrency assets and monitor account activities. Simply create an account on the official website for management, and use this App for approval, you can manage large amount of assets, collaborate with your team, and make convenient transactions.

****** Multi-Cryptocurrency ******
Support networks such as BTC, ETH, BNB, SOL, DOGE, ADA, TRX, AVAX, TON, CET, LTC, POL, BCH, ETC, FTM, ARB, BASE, KAS, OP, XEC, and 1,000,000+ tokens, with more networks coming soon.

****** Group Wallet ******
Manage crypto assets with your team members, support on-chain features such as sending, receiving, DApp interaction, contract interaction, staking, etc. Ensure clear and traceable views of asset flow and participating members by initiating request >> approval >> multi-signing >> broadcasting process.
Batch transfer, batch approval, batch signing facilitate you to complete the operation in one click.
You can modify the team multi-signature mode m/n or turn on/off the approval process at any time to flexibly manage team collaboration.
The featured accidental protection avoids the inability to fulfill the multi-signature requirement under accidental circumstances and prevents the loss of private keys by individual members, bringing more protection to your assets.

****** Personal Wallet ******
Personal wallet also supports on-chain features such as sending, receiving, DApp interaction, contract interaction, staking, etc. You only need to use the official website to initiate transactions and cooperate with the app to approve, and securely manage your assets.
The featured transaction accelerator boosts your trading efficiency.

iphone.title: Echo Wallet

The Echo wallet is a fast, secure way to store and manage cryptocurrencies. It also enables you to use the Echo network, a sidechain-powered Layer 2 infrastructure that enables new decentralized application functionality for Bitcoin and Ethereum.

Non-custodial: All private keys are stored in the Echo wallet on your device and only you have access to them. You are responsible for the backup and safekeeping of your private keys.

Name service:  Choose a username for your blockchain identity instead of having to remember a long public key identifier.

Smart contracts: Use decentralized apps and smart contracts built on Echo seamlessly from the Echo wallet by signing transactions.

Bluetooth: Request and send payments to your friends using Bluetooth.

Fee calculator: Automatically calculates the best transaction fee for instant payment confirmation.

Transaction history: See a complete log of transaction and smart contract usage.

QR Codes: Enable camera access to be able to scan and pay via QR code, no manual typing necessary.

PIN protection: Protect your wallet and funds using an extra, secure PIN code.

iphone.title: OneArt: Web3 Wallet & Browser
iphone.description:
OneArt: Crypto Wallet for DeFi and NFTs with In-App Web3 Browser.

TRUSTED BY MORE THAN 400,000 USERS WORLDWIDE

With OneArt Web3 Wallet, you can easily manage your crypto assets in a single application with a user-friendly interface made just for you. Import an unlimited number of wallets and start using a wallet in just a few clicks. 

WEB3-NATIVE, SECURE, USER-FRIENDLY. All you need in Web3 in a Single App.

The app supports  Ethereum, BNB Smart Chain, Polygon, Fantom, Avalanche, Arbitrum and Venom blockchains. 

Your privacy and security are our priority. ONEART IS NON-CUSTODIAL: private keys and seed phrases are under your control, and we don’t have access to any of your private data.

Manage your wallet addresses and multiple digital assets on different blockchains simultaneously, easily, and conveniently.

Explore the unlimited world without leaving the wallet. 

– EXTENDED TOKEN DETAILS 
All data about the token (market cap, price change, descriptions, etc.) is available right in the app with CoinGecko token list integration.

– NFT PREVIEW & MANAGEMENT
Preview & manage your NFT collections right in the wallet. 

– OPTIMIZED TRANSACTION FEES
Save on your fees with the advanced gas settings.

– ENHANCED SECURITY WITH iCLOUD BACKUP
With OneArt, you can easily back up your encrypted private data (seed phrase and private keys) to your iCloud Keychain, so you will not lose it.

iphone.title: Tuyo: Speed up your money
iphone.description:
Meet Tuyo, the world’s first truly borderless, self-custodial finance app. We give you full control of your digital dollars (USDC), real-world banking features, global transfers and yield-earning tools all in one beautiful, lightning-fast interface.

Why You’ll Love Tuyo

Self-Custody & Next-Gen Security
Your private keys never leave your device, so there are no middlemen, no custodial risk, and you enjoy total peace of mind knowing you’re the sole owner of your funds.

Real Bank Account Numbers in Your Name
Instantly access free USD, EUR and MXN account numbers and IBANs under your own name. Get paid like a local anywhere in the world, and watch funds convert automatically into USDC so you’re always ready to move at a moment’s notice.

Free, Instant Global Transfers
Send USDC as EUR, USD, MXN and more in seconds, with zero fees between Tuyo users and minimal on‑chain costs otherwise, no borders, no surprises.

Spend USDC at 140 Million+ Merchants
Order your Tuyo Card right from the app and tap and go with Apple Pay; it accepts USDC natively on Base and settles in local currency, letting you shop online or in‑store just like a regular debit card without ever entrusting your funds to a bank.

Earn Yield Effortlessly
Dive into built-in staking, vaults and DeFi integrations curated for safety and performance, then sit back and watch your holdings grow 24/7, no spreadsheets, no guesswork.

Modern, Intuitive Design
Every screen is crafted for clarity: detailed transaction histories, real-time portfolio insights and one-tap navigation, so whether you’re a DeFi veteran or crypto-curious, you’ll feel right at home.

iphone.title: Gordian Seed Tool
iphone.description:
Gordian Seed Tool protects your cryptographic seeds while also making them available for easy use. Using Seed Tool, you can generate seeds and store them securely on your device. You can then derive and share multi-signature signing and verification keys from those seeds or use them to sign PSBTs. Sophisticated backup procedures include printed pages and Sharded Secret Key Reconstruction (SSKR) — which lets you split your seed into pieces and send them to trusted parties, who can send them back to you in an emergency for seed recovery. You can even use an entirely offline device (no internet access) to store your seeds and use QR codes to exchange accounts, descriptors, seeds, keys, or PSBTs with online devices running compatible wallet or signing software.

The "seeds" generated and protected by Gordian Seed Tool are long strings of truly random numbers used in cryptography. As the name suggests, seeds are the starting point for other things such as cryptocurrency keys and addresses. To be secure, seeds need to be created and saved safely.

NOTE: Gordian Seed Tool is not a cryptocurrency wallet. It does not store or transmit value in any cryptocurrency, but it can be used in conjunction with such tools.

Gordian Seed Tool is open-source software from Blockchain Commons, a not-for-profit public-good organization. Find our repository on GitHub and check out the code for yourself!

iphone.title: O3: Cross-Chain Wallet
iphone.description:
O3 Cross-Chain Wallet 

As a mobile cross-chain smart wallet specially built for DeFi users, we have always been committed to providing users with digital asset management services that are 100% non-custodial, safe, and reliable; one-stop efficient and convenient cross-chain operation entry.

In O3 Cross-Chain Wallet, we support one-click switching of any EVM compatible chains and custom networks, and managing crypto assets on multiple blockchains within one wallet. The built-in cross-chain DEX aggregator can integrat Swap, Bridge, Hub and others into a magic button. While eliminating the redundant cross-chain operation steps, by aggregating the liquidity from DEXs on each chain, it can get the optimal price path in real-time. Also, users get more choices in cross-chain assets, not only bridging symmetric native assets, but also swapping asymmetric native assets across chains, and even exchanging the Gas assets on any EVM compatible chains.

In the future, O3 Cross-Chain Wallet will integrate more DEXs and cross-chain protocols, so that everyone can trade across chains more efficiently. Finally, the O3 protocol can realize value transfer among multiple chains and assets with minimal operations.

iphone.title: Presearch Privacy Browser
iphone.description:
Presearch is a private search engine that protects your privacy. Enjoy unbiased results with no tracking, no data collection, and no profiling of your searches

Our Key Differentiators:

Community Project

Community members can actively participate in the project using Presearch community chat groups, contributing open source packages to our source code repository, or simply as users or promoters helping build usage and awareness

Decentralized Platform

Presearch is now preparing to release its first decentralized technology – a new search engine experience that runs on node servers operated by Presearch community members.

Better Search Results

The new Presearch Engine offers results that are as good as the world’s top search engines. It also provides an additional layer of data through community packages which makes those results even better. For example, you can search Presearch for “Bitcoin” to see what the crypto package looks like. Over time, there will be additional results provided by a user-curated supplementary index.

Privacy

In addition to better results, Presearch also protects your privacy because it does not track you or store your searches, and queries are handled by a decentralized network of node servers processing anonymized queries.

A New Kind Of Advertising Model

In addition to offering users a great search experience, Presearch is dedicated to creating significant value for marketers who would like to reach Presearch users. Advertisers can stake their PRE to a keyword, and whichever advertiser stakes the most tokens will have its ads displayed when a user searches on the term selected. Advertisers confer the most external value on PRE, so their success is very important to the ecosystem.

The Presearch Privacy Browser is a fork of a popular privacy brower. Many of the designs and functionalities are the same, but allows the user to use Presearch on a mobile device.

iphone.title: Hashrate
iphone.description:
Introducing Hashrate – the ultimate crypto mining app for miners of all levels! With Hashrate, you can effortlessly monitor all your mining rigs from one convenient place, no matter where you are.

What sets Hashrate apart is its cross-platform compatibility – it works seamlessly on iOS, iPadOS, and macOS devices. Plus, it supports multiple pools, so you can keep track of all your mining activities in one app.

And the best part? Hashrate's lock-screen widgets make it easy to keep tabs on your miners without even unlocking your device. You can customize your widgets to display all your farms, and they look stunning in Dark Mode too!

For those who like to crunch numbers, Hashrate comes equipped with a built-in calculator that lets you calculate your profits and energy costs anytime, anywhere.

iphone.title: Ethereum Mining Monitor
iphone.description:
Ethereum Mining Monitor allows you to remotely monitor multiple ethereum mining rigs, view and update supported mining pool accounts, and view current and historical market data of crypto currencies from your iOS device.  

Features:
- Currently supports 58 mining pools and 26 coins. New pools and coins added per request.
- Supports ethOS, a large-scale deployment 64-bit linux distro that mines ETH, ETC, EXP and other Dagger Hashimoto coins out-of-the-box.
- Supports MonitorRig, a Windows monitoring tool that can list the GPU and hardware informations when running Ethminer.
- Supports Ethpool.org, a predictable solo mining pool with servers located in Europe, Asia and North America. 
- Supports Ethermine.org, a high performance ethereum mining pool which is a direct successor of ethpool.org.
- You can add and manage multiple ethOS accounts  
- You can add and manage multiple MonitoRig accounts 
- You can add and manage multiple Ethpool.org accounts 
- You can add and manage multiple Ethermine.org accounts 
- You can add and manage multiple Nanopool accounts (ETH, ETC, PASC, SIA, XMR, ZEC)
- You can add and manage multiple zcash.flypool.org Zcash accounts (ZEC)
- You can add and manage multiple NomNom-Technology Musicoin accounts (MUSIC)
- You can add and manage multiple MiningClub.info Musicoin accounts (MUSIC)
- You can add and manage multiple TrustFarm.io Musicoin accounts (MUSIC)
- You can add and manage multiple ExpansePool Expanse accounts (EXP)
- You can add and manage multiple Kicker4gamers.org Ethereum Classic accounts (ETC)
- You can add and manage multiple Litecoinpool.org Litecoin accounts (LTC)
- You can add and manage multiple Siamining.com Siacoin accounts (SIA)
- You can view the total hashrate for all GPUs of all rigs, also hashrate per Rig and hashrate per GPU
- You can monitor the temperature of each GPU (celsius), status of the rig, mining time, and more
- You can view unpaid balances, payouts and update mining pool settings
- You can monitor any available cryptocurrency for price variation.
- Receive notifications when an ethOS mining rig is inactive
- Receive notification when a cryptocurrency being monitored reaches the set price criteria.
- You can view real time and historical market data of cryptocurrencies.

website: http://robegamesios.wixsite.com/ethminingmonitor

iphone.title: TradingView: Track All Markets
iphone.description:
In a nutshell, we’re where the world charts, chats and trades markets. Over 100 million people use our social network and supercharged supercharts to make better, brighter decisions when they trade. Download our app to access free charts, alerts, advanced watchlists, plus discuss latest trends with other traders and much, much more. Here’s a fuller feature set: 

World-leading charts
A trader’s rite of passage, charts power insight. Millions use ours – for free – to make better decisions in the markets. Our charts work on any device and outperform many desktop trading platforms. You’ll be able to search for stocks, currencies, cryptos, futures, CFDs and more. A wide range of drawing tools (like Gann Fans and Elliott Waves) and technical indicators will also help you analyze price action.

Simple Pine Script for complex tools
From coding to chart analysis, faster than ever before — we crafted our programming language to give you the power to create custom tools. Pine Script is elegantly minimalist, pre-integrated with data, and breaking your analysis limits.

Bar Replay to hit rewind on past insights 
Watch how pricing data unfolded historically. Rewind markets and review at speed and resolution you desire.

Unmissable alerts 
Trading alerts were never this powerful, flexible, and easy to use. Cloud-based, they are available on any device – get notified by email, app, desktop, or webhook when your alerts trigger.

Made to trade 
Trade directly on our charts – trade through top brokers integrated to our platform, or use Paper Trading to practice buying and selling securities without any of the risk.

One app to track them all
Get a comprehensive view of the financial markets with our app: live quotes, news, trends, financial statements, and fundamentals, all in one place at your fingertips – the fastest way to find all the data you need.

Total economics and corporate reports
Access the latest and upcoming economic events, world companies' earnings, and dividends, in one Calendar.

Watchlist what matters
Keep track of all your beloved stocks and currency pairs with our highly-customizable watchlists. Use them to see real-time price updates and be the first to know what’s moving in the markets – wherever you happen to be. 

Data. Data. Data, 
Gain access to real-time market data from exchanges in the US, Europe and Asia. Hundreds of thousands of financial symbols from 100+ exchanges are at your fingertips. Unless you have incredibly niche interests, you’ll find what you’re looking for.

Never trade alone again
Unleash your creativity onto the world markets by being part of the largest social network for traders and investors. With thousands of ideas and minds published daily and ability to customize and share your analysis, start building your following today.

Always at your fingertips
Our secure and reliable cloud-based infrastructure means you’ll always have access to the world of finance, 24/7. No unexpected downtime at a critical trading moment ever again.  

Terms of use: https://www.tradingview.com/policies/
Privacy policy: https://www.tradingview.com/privacy-policy/
